title: Choose the page structure
question: The look is already set by your video (warm paper, indigo, Montserrat + mono keys). Pick how the page is put together.

options.label: One copy, followed
options.lineage: scroll story around one real clipboard item
options.thesis: The page follows one copied address from lost, to found at your cursor, to pinned and pasted anywhere.
materials: real Stash UI rebuilt in HTML
options.viewport: A live note window reading 'My address is |' with the Stash paste menu open at the caret; you can press ⌘⇧V and 1–9 yourself. Headline and Download .dmg sit at the right.
options.risk: The full shortcut reference and install steps come after the story, lower on the page.

options.label: The field manual
options.thesis: A beautifully set manual: every shortcut, feature and install step, indexed by its key.
options.viewport: A title page with the app icon, a one-line promise and Download, above a keycap index of the 9 shortcuts that works as the table of contents.
options.risk: Reads as documentation; less 'watch it work' energy up top.

options.label: The page is Stash
options.lineage: the app's own full window at page scale
options.thesis: The site is a giant Stash window: its history list is the navigation, the preview pane shows each feature.
options.viewport: One huge Stash window: the search bar holds the tagline, the list (Paste menu, Quick paste, Privacy, Install…) on the left, the selected item's preview on the right; Download is the 'Paste ↵' button. ↑↓ walks it.
options.risk: Unusual navigation; on phones it must fall back to a normal scroll.
